description.sub_name: 電聲元件系統整合與產品實作
description.sub_ename: SYSTEM INTEGRATION AND PRODUCT MANUFACTURING OF ELECTRO-ACOUSTIC COMPONENTS
description.describe_ch: 本課程旨在指導學生認識電聲產品材料及物性基礎，並進而認識電聲元件對系統之特性影響及系統整合。以產品實作並搭配校外教學，參訪電聲相關企業與產業，提供學生對電聲產品及其上下游產業環境的認識。
description.describe_eh: This course aims to guide students in understanding electro-acoustic products' material and physical properties. The influence of the different characteristics of electro-acoustic components, system integration, and product implementation will be studied. The course will also coordinate with off-campus education, such as visiting enterprises and manufacturers, to provide students with knowledge of electro-acoustic products and their industrial environments.

courseBankC.core_eng: The ability to apply fundamental scientific knowledge and systematic thinking to explore, analyze, and diagnose electro-acoustic engineering problems and develop sustainable solutions.
